body:
You don't have to use the `setMapMoveSinceLastRefine` to enable map-move refinement. Its usage is mostly for non map-move refinement (the users have to click on a button to trigger refine). Here is [an example](https://codesandbox.io/s/62n7okrkyr) that implements map-move refinement with Leaflet.

The example is built with latest version of InstantSearch (version 3).  It's a beta version but the stable comes soon. Take a look [at the migration guide](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/upgrade-guides/js#upgrade-from-v2-to-v3) in case you want to update. Note that the example is basic and might not handle all the edge cases.
